annotation.authors_or_issuer: UNESCO Office in Montevideo and Regional Bureau for Science
key_provisions_or_claims: Argentina's Subsecretaría de Tecnologías de la Información adopted Disposición 2/23 on 2 June 2023.
The Disposición is based on the UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI, approved by 193 member states.
It aims to set clear rules so that all sectors benefit from technology and to strengthen the national innovation ecosystem.
UNESCO calls for ethical principles to counter manipulation, inequality, bias and erosion of human rights.
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: UNESCO news item reporting that Argentina's Subsecretaría de Tecnologías de la Información adopted Disposición 2/23 on 2 June 2023, incorporating the UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI into national policy to promote responsible AI use. General AI ethics; no robotics content.
annotation.title_clean: Argentina implementa normativa en base a la Recomendación sobre la Ética de la Inteligencia Artificial de la UNESCO
annotation.title_en: Argentina implements regulation based on the UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence
